text:
maya: OK team — we need a short prioritization sync for the Optimize toolkit + evals workstream for next quarter. Customers keep asking for clearer batching/caching recommendations, better regression alerts tied to prompt sets, and an easy way to share prompt libraries. How do we slice this for Q1?

ev an: Good call. Can we separate into three deliverables: 1) Batching & KV-cache guide + auto-suggest rules, 2) Prompt-set regression detection pipeline + alerting, 3) Prompt library UX + export?

maya: Yep that's what I had in mind. For prioritization I care about immediate customer impact (CS signals), unit-cost wins, and low engineering risk.

priya: Suggest quantifying launch criteria up-front so PM/Eng agree. Proposed OKRs: reduce per-token cost by 15% for targeted workloads, detect 90%+ of regressions on seed prompt sets within 24h, and 3rd-party prompt export (JSON) supported. Thoughts?

zack: For regression detection we should define signal types: semantic drift (embedding-based), IO-level diffs (token-level LM divergence), and metric regressions on eval harness. For thresholds, 90% recall is ambitious but doable if we tune prompts and embeddings.

rachel: From CS — top customers (fintech + commerce) want: per-route batching suggestions (they can’t over-batch latency-sensitive routes), alerting when quality drops for a named prompt set, and a way to annotate prompts with customer metadata. If we can demo a prompt library and "subscribe to alert" UX, it'll help renewals.

oliver: UX notes — keep prompt library simple: list view with tags + quick-run. For alerts, let users opt-in per-prompt-set and choose threshold presets (conservative / aggressive). Small mock next week.

tom: Engineering constraints: KV cache improvements need a runtime change (low-to-mid effort) and a metrics pipeline to emit per-route seq-length distributions. Prototype plan: feature-flagged autosuggest that recommends batch_size & cache_ttl based on recent 24h traces.

maya: Good. Can we sketch a minimal MLP for Q1 (MVP) vs stretch? MVP: autosuggest rules + CSV prompt import/export + basic regression detector (embedding drift + diff alerts). Stretch: automatic rollbacks, UI alert templates, per-route adaptive batching.

ev an: Timeline-wise: 6w for MVP infra + API + basic UI. If we parallelize (runtime + eval infra + UI) we can hit that. Need a small spike to estimate KV changes — I'll own it.

priya: Customer-facing launch criteria checklist (proposed): 1) docs/guides for batching & caching with examples, 2) demo prompt library + import/export, 3) regression detector running on 2 internal prompt sets for 2 weeks with <=5% false positives, 4) CS playbook for onboarding.

zack: Small technical addendum: eval harness should capture these signals: embedding cosine, LM perplexity delta, and downstream task accuracy (where applicable). Example config snippet for prompt sets:```
name: checkout_total_prompts
prompts: ["calc_total_v1", "calc_total_v2"]
alert_thresholds:
  embedding_drift: 0.12
  perplexity_delta: 1.5
  downstream_delta_pct: 3
```

rachel: If we can show a customer-facing report that ties a regression to a specific prompt change + token cost delta, that'll be huge. Even if the report is "beta".

maya: Action items — Maya: book a 60m roadmap triage Mon 9am to finalize scope. Evan: spike KV cache complexity (due Fri). Tom: draft infra metrics plan (seq-length histogram + per-route token counts). Oliver: put up two quick mocks by EOD Wed. Priya: write OKR proposal doc + launch checklist by Friday. Zack: prepare eval config template and a small pilot set. Rachel: pull top 5 customer asks and any contracts with explicit SLA asks.

deploy-bot: deploy started for staging/optimize-toolkit-spike @ 1876543240 :rocket:

maya: Thanks all — we'll iterate Monday. Short thread here, bring detailed numbers to the triage.
